title: Discounts
description: Manage promotional codes and automatic discounts.

help.title: About Discounts
help.overview: A discount is a code the shopper enters. The cart holds one discount at a time. It is checked again whenever the cart is re-priced, and dropped if it no longer qualifies. The code is stored in uppercase. Title, type, value, what it applies to, and a start date are required.

sections.title: When the amount is calculated
sections.body: The cart sets the unit price first: catalog price, then one pricing rule. The discount is taken off that price. Gift-card lines are never discounted and do not count toward minimums.
items: Percentage takes that percent off the lines in scope. Fixed takes a flat amount, never more than those lines.
Free shipping does not reduce the merchandise total. Checkout waives the shipping charge while this discount is applied.
Buy X get Y groups the eligible units as buy quantity plus get quantity, then subtracts the cheapest units in each complete group.
Applies to order covers every merchandise line. Product, category, or collection covers only the targets you select. Category matches any category on the product.

sections.title: What blocks the code
sections.body: The discount must be active and inside its start and end. An empty end date means it does not expire.
items: Usage limit stops the code after that many uses. Usage limit per customer counts non-cancelled orders for that customer.
Minimum order amount and minimum quantity use merchandise only, after pricing rules.
Customer groups saved on the discount are not checked when the code is applied.
